web_events.query: Federal Reserve speech this week monetary policy
web_events.answer: The Federal Reserve decided to keep its key interest rate unchanged at its meeting this week, marking the fifth consecutive meeting with no change in the benchmark rate. The decision was made despite ongoing high inflation and energy price spikes due to the Iran war. The Fed's rate-setting committee reached a 9-3 decision, with three officials dissenting in favor of a rate increase. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh described the policy discussion as a "good family fight." web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official July PMI data is expected to be released on Friday. The market anticipates the manufacturing PMI to remain at 50.3, while the non-manufacturing PMI is expected to slightly decrease to 50.2 from June's 50.3. ING forecasts a slightly weaker outcome, predicting the manufacturing PMI at 50.1 and the non-manufacturing PMI at 50.0.
